📄 Smart Form Filler Pro — Offline

Open any PDF or scanned form image (JPG, PNG), or drag & drop it here.
Fill it in Bangla or English, add ticks (✓), resize text, then print or save as PDF / Word / PNG. No internet needed.

💡 Quick guide
  • Click & type: click any blank spot on the form to create a text box. Type in English or Bangla (Avro / Bijoy Unicode).
  • Auto Scan: press 🔍 Auto Scan to detect blank lines and checkboxes and turn them into fillable boxes.
  • Ticks & signature: choose ☑️ Tick or ❎ Cross and click a box. Use ✍️ Signature / Image for a signature, photo or seal.
  • Resize & move: select a box, use A- / A+ for text size, drag the blue corner dot to resize, drag the top tab to move, or nudge with the arrow keys.
  • Save: Save PDF for a flattened PDF, Save Word for a .docx where the text stays editable.

✍️ Draw a signature or upload an image

Draw with the mouse or touch below, or pick a signature / passport photo / seal image from your computer.
